title: Israeli Drone Strike Near Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital Kills Palestinian Doctor in Deir al-Balah
detail: An Israeli drone strike near Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital in Deir al-Balah, central Gaza, killed Dr. Jamal Abu Aoun, head of the anaesthesia department at Al-Yafa Medical Hospital, on May 30, 2026. Several other people were wounded in the attack. The strike was confirmed by Al Jazeera correspondents on the ground. The attack came during the fourth day of Eid al-Adha, which Israeli forces also marked with artillery shelling in eastern and southern Khan Younis and a separate drone strike near the Firas Market in Gaza City that killed one and wounded several others. The killing of a department head at a functioning medical facility drew immediate condemnation from the Palestinian health ministry and WHO. Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital in Deir al-Balah is one of the few hospitals still partially operational in Gaza, and Dr. Abu Aoun's death adds to the estimated 1,000+ healthcare workers killed since October 2023.

title: IDF Strikes Gaza City's Firas Market and Al-Bureij Camp; Artillery Shells Khan Younis
detail: Israeli forces conducted multiple attacks across Gaza on May 30, 2026, the fourth day of Eid al-Adha. A drone strike near the Firas Market — one of Gaza City's busiest commercial areas — killed at least one Palestinian and wounded several others. Separately, Israeli artillery shelled areas east and south of Khan Younis, and Al-Bureij refugee camp in central Gaza was also struck by Israeli artillery. Israeli forces continued demolition of homes in Beit Lahiya in northern Gaza. The attacks occurred as Israel pressed forward with 'Operation Gideon's Chariots,' with Netanyahu ordering expansion of Israeli territorial control from approximately 60% to 70% of Gaza beyond the October 2025 ceasefire Yellow Line. The post-ceasefire Palestinian death toll stands at approximately 930 killed, 2,819 wounded since October 11, 2025.

title: Hezbollah Fires Two Rockets at Kiryat Shmona; Both Intercepted by Israeli Air Defense
detail: Hezbollah fired two rockets toward Kiryat Shmona in northern Israel on May 30, 2026, both of which were intercepted by Israeli air defense systems. The rockets triggered air raid sirens across the northern Israeli city, which sits approximately 3 kilometers from the Lebanese border. No casualties were reported. The attack comes amid ongoing Hezbollah strikes as part of the 'Axis of Resistance' campaign in solidarity with Gaza, despite the October 2025 ceasefire. The Times of Israel liveblog noted the interception on May 31. Israel has continued to respond to Hezbollah rocket fire with air strikes on southern Lebanon. Bennett and Lapid publicly called for a 'powerful response' to Hezbollah attacks on May 30.

title: West Bank Settler Attacks: Stone-Throwing in Beita, Knife Attack in Qusra, Farmland Damage near Hebron
detail: Multiple settler attacks struck West Bank Palestinian communities on May 30, 2026. In Beita, south of Nablus, settlers threw stones and smashed windows of Palestinian vehicles overnight; security camera footage showed five individuals in dark hoodies carrying clubs. In Qusra, also south of Nablus, a Palestinian was lightly wounded in a settler knife attack. In Khirbet el-Muraq in Masafer Yatta, south of Hebron, settlers damaged farmland and olive trees. The incidents reflect the ongoing surge in West Bank settler violence, which OCHA documents at an average of 27 incidents per month in early 2026 — up from 2 per month in 2020. UN OHCHR reported 122 Palestinians killed in the West Bank in April 2026, including 22 children and 8 women, the highest monthly toll since documentation began.
